item.description:
New • Ports an agent left open are traced back to the session that started them, and you're told when a session ends with one still running • CPU use is attributed to each agent session • Spend is counted on the day it happened, not the day a session last ran
Improved • The menu bar icon and system sampling use far less CPU • Meaning search now covers the whole of long sessions, not just their start • Clicking a remote notification opens its session. Re-run the install command on remote hosts to get actvt-cli 0.5.0
Fixed • Codex sessions from the ChatGPT app showed no messages, and edits were missing from files touched • Sessions interrupted by an API error showed no cost • Searching for a hyphenated term, such as a file or branch name

New • Basic licences no longer show an expiry date.
Improved • Anonymous usage data, when you have it switched on.
Fixed • The welcome screen no longer runs past the top of its window.

New • Sessions from the pi coding agent, local and remote, with transcripts, cost, search, resume and the MCP tools • Notifications lead with the session name. The project sits underneath and the body says what happened • With previews hidden, the lock screen shows only the kind of event, never a session name or transcript text
Improved • actvt-cli 0.4.0 lists pi sessions. Re-run the install command on remote hosts to pick it up
